about.title: About Daniel
about.bio: I am Daniel Seguin, a Senior Analyst Developer with over three decades of experience in software engineering, enterprise application support, and modernization programs.
about.journey: My career has been built around practical delivery: maintaining critical legacy systems, modernizing enterprise applications, documenting complex databases, and helping teams move from uncertainty to working software.
about.positioning: I combine deep legacy expertise with modern Angular, Python, PowerShell, .NET, API, data, and AI-assisted development practices. That mix helps founders and small businesses move quickly without losing sight of maintainability.
about.vision: My DaaS model is for entrepreneurs who want to transform an idea into a real, deployable software solution without the high costs normally associated with traditional development. Instead of paying tens of thousands before seeing a concrete result, founders subscribe for $100/month and receive continuous progress powered by GitHub Copilot, modern development tools, and my 30 years of consulting experience.
